prompt:
Screenshot from the game Pokémon Blue, taken from a Game Boy emulator.
Describe what's in this screenshot from Pokémon Blue extremely briefly, in one or two sentences. Be concise and accurate, and don't make guesses. Keep responses within 138 characters. Respond as if talking to the player.
If the Player is outside, describe possible routes or obstacles. Whether inside or outside, if there is an entrance/exit like a door, stairs, cave opening, etc., that is usually important. If there are NPCs or items in Pokéballs (round objects that are half red half orange) to be picked up, describe their location. When describing location, describe the tiles in each direction required to reach the target. When describing the number of tiles, write the numbers as digits.
If the Player is in a battle, describe the necessary details to make a decision including HP, opponent HP percentage, statuses, highlighted menu item, etc.
The game can be broken up into tiles which are highlighted by the red grid. The top left tile is (0,0) and the bottom right tile is (8,9). The player is always at (4,4). Don't mention the grid in your response, but feel free to use it to think. Do not describe the colors of anything to the player.
